description: Get overall summary statistics for the current model from the loaded solve results: power/transmission/energy capacity, dispatch, emissions, capital/operational/total cost — each broken down by carrier — plus unmet load and LOLH per bus. This is the whole-horizon total; for a per-year breakdown use get_yearly_results. Pass scenario_id for a specific scenario; omit for the base case. Optionally filter to one bus. Read-only.

bus_id.description: Optional bus ID to filter the summary.

include_zero.description: Keep carriers with nothing in a table (the full matrix). Default false: only carriers with a value, so the answer is what happened.

scenario_id.description: Which scenario to read: a scenario id number for a named scenario, or the string "base" for the Base Scenario (the as-built network — it has NO numeric id, so never pass a guessed number for it). Omit to use the current scenario.

name: get_summary_stats
